streams.notes: Session rollouts under YYYY/MM/DD: the complete event stream. Top-level types (0.149.1): session_meta, event_msg, response_item, world_state, turn_context. Pinned writer evidence adds custom_tool_call/custom_tool_call_output to the fixture-backed response items. token_count carries CUMULATIVE total_token_usage, not per-message deltas. Roles include 'developer'. Can embed compaction history and grow large.

Version-suffixed WAL-mode SQLite stores created on first run at 0.149.1: goals_1, logs_2, memories_1, queue_1, state_5 (150 migrations), thread_history_1 (+ -wal/-shm). thread_history_1 is codex's OWN rollout->SQLite projection with per-thread byte-offset cursors (thread_history_projection_state.next_rollout_byte_offset) — rollouts stay the source of truth. state_5.threads holds session metadata; rollout_migration_state instruments the JSONL migration. Schema dump: sources/<version>.sqlite-schema.sql.
Rollout writer coordination locks (.coordination.lock) — runtime artifacts, no data value.
Config incl. model_providers (base_url/env_key/wire_api), history.persistence, sqlite_home (migration watch).
Prompt history; governed by history.persistence = save-all|none and history.max_bytes.
Credentials — MUST-NOT-PARSE; inventory only, excluded from harvests.
Headless stream-json stdout — corroboration surface captured by the farm, not part of the agent data root.
